福爾摩沙小導遊臺南 Tainan・安平區

東興洋行Julius Mannich & Co. Merchant House

考大家一個謎語：德國商人請台灣師傅蓋一棟西式商館，會蓋出什麼？1858 年《天津條約》開放四個口岸：淡水、雞籠、安平和打狗（今高雄）。1875 年，做樟腦和糖生意的德國商人曼尼希蓋了這座洋行。台灣割讓給日本後，樟腦和鴉片收歸專賣，洋商的生意做不下去了。東興洋行在 1898 年歇業。後來它當過支廳、派出所、鹽廠廠長宿舍，1986 年起成為博物館。房子面向大海、氣候潮濕，所以整棟架高；基座是滿是小孔的咕咾石。中西合璧：德國老闆要的對稱與拱廊，台灣師傅鋪上廟宇式屋瓦。數數欄杆上的青釉花瓶：八個。台語的「八」聽起來像「發」。

Here's a riddle: what do you get when a German businessman asks Taiwanese craftsmen to build a Western office? The Treaty of Tianjin of 1858 opened four ports: Tamsui, Keelung, Anping, and Dagou, today's Kaohsiung. In 1875, the German businessman Julius Mannich, who traded camphor and sugar, built this merchant house. After Taiwan was ceded to Japan, camphor and opium became government monopolies. The traders were squeezed dry. Julius Mannich and Company closed in 1898. Later it became a district office, a police station, a salt works manager's dormitory, and since 1986, a museum. The house faces the sea and the air is damp, so it is raised up. The base is made of coral rock, full of tiny holes. East meets West: symmetry and arches for the German owner, temple-style roof tiles from Taiwanese craftsmen. Count the green vases on the railing: eight. In Taiwanese, eight sounds like prosper.

One-minute intro

為什麼值得來

Why it matters & history

東興洋行是德國商人在安平開港後建的商館，中西合璧：德國人要的對稱拱廊，配上台灣師傅熟悉的廟宇式屋瓦，基座用咕咾石砌成。它和德記洋行一起，訴說安平的國際貿易年代。

The Julius Mannich & Co. merchant house was built by a German trader after Anping opened to foreign trade. It blends Western arcades with temple-style roof tiles laid by Taiwanese builders, on a base of coral stone.

  1. 1858《天津條約》開放淡水、雞籠、安平、打狗四個口岸。The Treaty of Tianjin opens four Taiwan ports, including Anping.
  2. 1875做樟腦與糖生意的德國商人曼尼希建造洋行。German merchant Julius Mannich, a camphor and sugar trader, builds the house.
  3. 1898樟腦等收歸專賣後，洋行歇業。After camphor becomes a government monopoly, the firm closes.
  4. 1986在當過支廳、派出所、鹽廠宿舍之後，成為博物館。After serving as an office, a police post and staff housing, it becomes a museum.

認識景點

About the place

洋行：外國商人的商館；曼尼希在 1875 年蓋了這一座。 天津條約：1858 年開放淡水、雞籠、安平、打狗四個口岸。 樟腦：從樟樹提煉的產品；曼尼希做樟腦和糖的生意。 專賣、壟斷：只有一個賣家（例如政府）可以賣某樣東西。

merchant house: A foreign company's office and trading house. Julius Mannich built this one in 1875. the Treaty of Tianjin: In 1858 it opened four ports: Tamsui, Keelung, Anping and Dagou. camphor: A product made from camphor trees. Mannich traded camphor and sugar. monopoly: When only one seller, like the government, is allowed to sell something.

咕咾石（珊瑚礁岩）：珊瑚形成的石頭，充滿小孔。 通風：讓新鮮空氣流通。 架高結構：離開地面架高的建築，底下有通風孔。 對稱：左右兩邊一樣，像照鏡子。

coral rock: Stone made from old coral, full of tiny holes. ventilation: Letting fresh air move through a place. elevated structure: A building raised above the ground, with air holes underneath. symmetry: When the left side and the right side are the same, like a mirror.

拱廊陽台：房子外側一排拱圈的有頂走廊。 廟宇式屋瓦：像台灣廟宇的紅瓦；師傅照自己熟悉的工法蓋。 壁爐：室內生火的地方；這棟房子甚至有壁爐。 青釉花瓶：不多不少八個，因為「八」音近「發」。

arched verandah: A covered porch with a row of arches along the outside of a house. temple-style roof tiles: Red roof tiles like a Taiwanese temple. The craftsmen built the way they knew. fireplace: A place for a fire inside a room. This house even has fireplaces. green-glazed vase: There are exactly eight, because eight sounds like prosper in Taiwanese.

博物館：1986 年起這棟建築成為博物館。

museum: Since 1986 the building has been a museum.

實景照片

Photos on site

東興洋行正面 The front of the house

這是東興洋行的正面，大約蓋於 1870 年代。五個紅磚圓拱後面是簷廊，可以遮陽又擋雨；欄杆是一個個綠釉花瓶。房子蓋在架高的咕咾石台基上，台基的小拱形通風口讓空氣流進去，防止受潮。

This is the front of the Julius Mannich house, built in the 1870s. Behind five red-brick arches is a verandah that gives shade and keeps off the rain. Its railing is made of green-glazed vases. The house sits on a raised coral-rock base, and small arched vents let air in to keep it dry.

東興洋行的咕咾石牆 Coral-rock wall

東興洋行架高的台基，是用咕咾石（珊瑚礁岩）砌成的。一塊塊珊瑚礁岩之間，用灰漿抹出凸起的灰縫，上面再砌一排紅磚。

The raised base of the Julius Mannich house is built of coral rock. Raised lines of mortar hold the rough coral blocks together, with a row of red bricks on top.

每塊都不一樣 Every block is different

靠近一點看：每塊石頭的花紋都不一樣，有的像蜂窩，有的像彎彎曲曲的迷宮，因為它們是由不同種類的珊瑚形成的。

Look closer. Every block has a different pattern, like a honeycomb or a maze, because different kinds of coral made them.

珊瑚蟲的家 Homes of coral polyps

看到一個個圓圓的小杯子了嗎？每個小杯子都曾住著一隻珊瑚蟲。珊瑚蟲會造出堅硬的骨骼，許多骨骼慢慢累積，就變成了珊瑚礁岩。

See the tiny round cups? Each one was once home to a coral polyp. Polyps build hard skeletons, and over time, many skeletons become coral rock.
